material.description: First-draw time is measured by hand over CDP with the cache off and varies 1.8 s to 14.7 s between runs on the same commit. Add a CI job that loads the Pages build with ?host=1, polls getState().frame.drawCalls, and asserts first draw under a ceiling, reporting the median of N loads. Witness: a green CI run printing firstDrawMs.
material.subject: No repeatable first-draw witness on the live page
material.witness: CI pages run on 601500a7, job 'first draw of the built page' conclusion success. Its log line: first-draw median-ms=2709 loads=3 ceiling-ms=10000 ok. Three cache-disabled loads of the built _site artifact in headless Chromium.
